Welcome

The soul of an old Tuscan estate

Here, the heart of the borgo still breathes through stone, light and landscape. Mornings arrive softly over the vineyards, afternoons linger beneath olive trees, and evenings unfold slowly — with candlelight, wine and the quiet elegance of the hills.

The Story

A house restored by time

Once a 17th-century farmhouse, Toscana Palace has been restored as a private estate where heritage is not displayed — it is felt. Old terracotta floors, hand-laid stone, olive groves and family vineyards shape a place made for slow arrivals and long memories.

Dining

Where the table becomes memory

From candlelit fine dining to a rustic osteria in the old borgo, every meal is shaped by the landscape — handmade pasta, estate olive oil, garden herbs and wines poured slowly as the sun leaves the hills.

The Winery

Wine from the heart of the estate

Beneath the old stone walls, the cellar keeps its own quiet ritual. Guests are invited to private tastings, vineyard walks and intimate evenings among French oak barrels, discovering the depth and patience of Tuscan wine.

Spa & Wellness

Silence, water and warm stone

An infinity pool facing the hills, slow body rituals, herbal oils and shaded terraces. Wellness at Toscana Palace is not a schedule — it is permission to disappear for a while.

Location

Getting here

Set above the vineyards of Val d’Orcia, Toscana Palace is reached by a quiet country road, approximately two hours from Florence Airport and close to Montalcino, Pienza and Siena.
